rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a deity or supernatural god.

example.english: The god worshipped at this temple is very responsive.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 miu6 baai3 ge3 san4 hou2 ling4

rows.note: Use this for the supreme God in Jewish or Christian contexts rather than for a deity in general.

example.english: I believe god will bless us.
example.jyutping: ngo5 seon3 soeng6 dai3 wui5 bou2 jau6 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a statue or image representing a deity.

example.english: People burn incense before this god statue every day.
example.traditional: 呢尊神像成日有人上香。
example.jyutping: ni1 zyun1 san4 zoeng6 seng4 jat6 jau5 jan4 soeng5 hoeng1
